notes.heading: Comparability
notes.text: FY2023 balance sheet and cash flow figures use the FY2024 comparative columns. The balance sheet reflects a change in presenting advances net of VAT. FY2024 uses the FY2025 comparative columns.

notes.heading: Audit opinions
notes.text: Each opinion was qualified because the group omitted the operating segment disclosures required by IFRS 8.

notes.heading: Cash after capex
notes.text: This is operating cash flow minus the cash purchase line for property, plant, equipment and intangibles. It excludes separately reported capitalized interest and right-of-use advances. PhosAgro’s published free cash flow uses a different definition.
